limitations: Complete current-source CUDA suite passes62 cases. The5669-tetrahedron sequence accepts39 fields and retains one unsupported pressure moment. Two finer8-port intrinsic-distance initializations fail allocation before mapping/recovery acceptance. Source snapshots, terminal status and failed logs remain exact; this checkpoint does not complete the physical-validation goal. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
